content.text: {"changes":[{"description":"Shift the mix toward workplace and team settings by replacing the low-stakes household chores domain with a second team-oriented domain, so most domains now involve human capacity directly.","new_value":["work schedules","study plans","event logistics","team projects","travel itineraries","small business operations","fitness programs","staffing rotations"]},{"description":"Remove the low-stakes household chores domain and replace it with a workplace shift-planning domain, keeping the rest of the list unchanged.","new_value":["work schedules","study plans","shift planning","event logistics","team projects","travel itineraries","small business operations","fitness programs"]},{"description":"Replace household chores with a second workplace-focused domain on deadline and sprint planning, increasing the share of settings where staff capacity is most at stake.","new_value":["work schedules","study plans","sprint planning","event logistics","team projects","travel itineraries","small business operations","fitness programs"]},{"description":"Keep the list size but swap household chores for an employee onboarding and training domain, adding another people-facing setting alongside work schedules and team projects.","new_value":["work schedules","study plans","employee onboarding","event logistics","team projects","travel itineraries","small business operations","fitness programs"]},{"description":"Replace the household chores and fitness programs entries with workplace domains (staff rota management and production line scheduling) to make the workplace share clearly dominant.","new_value":["work schedules","study plans","staff rota management","event logistics","team projects","travel itineraries","small business operations","production line scheduling"]}]}
